CustomField.description: Derives the fiscal-quarter label (Q1-Q4) and year from the Opportunity Close Date, e.g. "Q3-2026".
CustomField.formula: CASE( CEILING( MONTH( CloseDate ) / 3 ), 1, "Q1", 2, "Q2", 3, "Q3", 4, "Q4", "" ) & "-" & TEXT( YEAR( CloseDate ) )
CustomField.label: Expected Close Quarter
